working: A: LiAlH4 reduces PhCN to benzylamine (PhCH2NH2), not aniline. B: Hofmann bromamide degradation converts PhCONH2 to PhNH2 (aniline). C: NaBH4 does not reduce the nitro group to an amine. D: Acid hydrolysis of acetanilide gives aniline (as anilinium chloride, which gives aniline on workup). So B and D give aniline.
